name: Yamaha Robotics Co., Ltd.
india_angle: Yamaha Robotics Co., Ltd. announced the opening of an India office in 2026.
summary: Yamaha Robotics Co., Ltd. is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, specializing in back-end manufacturing equipment and electronic component assembly. They offer comprehensive solutions in die bonding, wire bonding, and flip chip bonding, serving advanced packaging and electronic assembly markets.
